info.name: PermissionGraph API
info.description: Complete PermissionGraph API collection generated from the repository endpoints and contracts. The collection uses collection-level bearer auth via {{accessToken}} and includes a runnable happy-path demo.

request.description: Liveness check. Does not require PostgreSQL or Redis.
Readiness check. Returns 200 Healthy or Degraded when Redis is unavailable, and 503 when PostgreSQL is unavailable.

exec: pm.test('Status is 200, 503, or degraded OK', function () { pm.expect([200, 503]).to.include(pm.response.code); });

item.name: 01 - Authentication
item.description: Registration, login, refresh, logout, and token-assisted account recovery endpoints.

request.description: Registers Alice Owner using the environment owner credentials.

exec: pm.test('Current user fields exist', function () { pm.expect(json).to.include.keys('userId', 'email', 'displayName'); });

request.description: Logs in Alice Owner and captures bearer and refresh tokens.
Rotates the current refresh token and captures the replacement tokens.
Revokes the current authenticated refresh session.
Revokes all refresh sessions for the authenticated user.
Requires a real email confirmation token. The local demo usually auto-confirms users when AUTH_AUTO_CONFIRM_EMAIL=true.

exec: pm.test('Status is 204 with a valid token or 400/401 with placeholder token', function () { pm.expect([204, 400, 401]).to.include(pm.response.code); });

request.description: Starts password reset flow. The API intentionally returns 204 without revealing whether an email exists.
Requires a real password reset token generated by the backend.

exec: pm.test('Status is 204 with a valid token or 400/401 with placeholder token', function () { pm.expect([204, 400, 401]).to.include(pm.response.code); });

request.description: Returns the authenticated user's profile.
Updates the authenticated user's display name.

exec: pm.test('Display name updated', function () { pm.expect(json.displayName).to.eql('Alice Owner Demo'); });

request.description: Creates a workspace owned by the authenticated user.
Lists organizations visible to the actor using cursor pagination.

exec: pm.test('List shape is cursor paginated', function () { pm.expect(json).to.include.keys('items', 'nextCursor', 'pageSize'); });

request.description: Reads a single visible organization.
Updates workspace metadata.
Transfers ownership to an active member. Keep out of the happy path unless intentionally demonstrating ownership transfer.

exec: pm.test('Status is 200 when prerequisites are met, otherwise safe failure', function () { pm.expect([200, 403, 409]).to.include(pm.response.code); });

request.description: Archives the workspace. This is intentionally not used in the happy path because it disables later demo requests.

exec: pm.test('Status is 204 when intentionally run, otherwise safe failure', function () { pm.expect([204, 403, 404, 409]).to.include(pm.response.code); });

request.description: Adds a registered user to the organization by email.
Lists members using cursor pagination.

exec: pm.test('List shape is cursor paginated', function () { pm.expect(json).to.include.keys('items', 'nextCursor', 'pageSize'); });

request.description: Reads a member by user ID.
Suspends Eve No Access. Avoid before running checks that require Eve as an active member.
Reactivates a suspended member.
Removes Eve No Access. Keep out of the happy path until the end of a manual demo.
Current non-owner leaves the organization.

exec: pm.test('Status is 204 for non-owner member, or safe failure if not eligible', function () { pm.expect([204, 404, 409]).to.include(pm.response.code); });

request.description: Creates a project resource in the workspace.
Lists projects with page/pageSize pagination.

exec: pm.test('List shape is page paginated', function () { pm.expect(json).to.include.keys('items', 'page', 'pageSize', 'totalCount'); });

request.description: Reads a project by ID inside the route organization.
Updates project metadata.
Archives the project. Keep out of the happy path until manual lifecycle cleanup.

item.name: 06 - Permission Catalog
item.description: Platform and custom permission catalog endpoints.

request.description: Lists platform permissions plus custom permissions visible in the organization.

exec: pm.test('Platform catalog is present', function () { pm.expect(json.items.some(x => x.key === 'pg.authorization.check_other_users')).to.eql(true); });

request.description: Creates a project-scoped custom permission for the demo.
Reads custom permission by ID.
Updates custom permission metadata.
Archives a custom permission. Keep out of the happy path until cleanup.
Reactivates an archived custom permission.

item.name: 07 - Roles
item.description: Custom role lifecycle and permission mapping endpoints.

request.description: Lists system and custom roles visible in the organization.
Creates a project-scoped custom role.

exec: pm.test('Role is project-scoped custom role', function () { pm.expect(json.roleType).to.eql('Custom'); pm.expect(json.scopeType).to.eql('Project'); });

request.description: Reads a role by ID.
Updates custom role metadata.
Clones a custom role.
Replaces a custom role's permissions.

exec: pm.test('Role permissions include custom permission', function () { pm.expect(json.permissionIds).to.include(pm.environment.get('customPermissionId')); });

request.description: Archives a custom role. Keep out of the happy path until cleanup.
Reactivates an archived custom role.

item.name: 08 - Role Assignments
item.description: Grant and revoke scoped role assignments.

request.description: Assigns a role to a member in organization or project scope.

exec: pm.test('Assignment is Active or Scheduled', function () { pm.expect(['Active', 'Scheduled']).to.include(json.status); });

request.description: Lists role assignments with filters.

exec: pm.test('List shape is page paginated', function () { pm.expect(json).to.include.keys('items', 'page', 'pageSize', 'totalCount'); });

request.description: Reads a role assignment by ID.
Revokes a role assignment and returns the updated assignment.

item.name: 09 - Authorization Check
item.description: Single and batch authorization decision endpoints.

request.description: Checks the authenticated actor's permission.

exec: pm.test('Owner override allows self check', function () { pm.expect(json.allowed).to.eql(true); pm.expect(json.reasonCode).to.eql('ALLOWED_OWNER_OVERRIDE'); });

request.description: Owner checks another user's permission decision.
Checks several permissions and preserves request order by correlation ID and index.

exec: pm.test('Batch returns ordered items', function () { pm.expect(json.items[0].correlationId).to.eql('owner-view'); pm.expect(json.items[1].index).to.eql(1); });

request.description: Explains the authenticated actor's access.
Owner explains another user's access and receives final decision parity with authorization check.

exec: pm.test('Explanation has final decision', function () { pm.expect(json.steps.some(x => x.code === 'FINAL_DECISION')).to.eql(true); });

item.name: 11 - Audit / Diagnostics
item.description: No public audit endpoint exists in the current API. Diagnostics are covered by the health endpoints in 00 - Health.

item.name: Security / Negative Checks
item.description: Focused negative checks for authentication, authorization, validation, and tenant safety.

request.description: Protected endpoint without bearer token.
Bob lacks pg.roles.assign and cannot grant access.
Owner checks Eve's permission. The decision should deny access without a server error.

item.name: User Without Explain Others Cannot Explain Another User

request.description: Eve is an active member but lacks pg.authorization.explain_others.

item.name: Explain Others Alone Does Not Permit Check Other

request.description: Carol has pg.authorization.explain_others in the happy path, but not pg.authorization.check_other_users.

exec: pm.test('check_other_users is required for check-other', function () { pm.expect(json.allowed).to.eql(false); pm.expect(json.reasonCode).to.eql('DENIED_CHECK_OTHER_USERS_NOT_ALLOWED'); });

request.description: Invalid or cross-tenant route identifiers return a safe error.

item.name: Invalid Request Body Returns Problem Details

request.description: Validation failure uses RFC 7807 Problem Details.

item.name: 99 - Full Happy Path Demo
item.description: Run this folder from top to bottom for a clean demo: owner creates workspace/project/catalog/roles, Bob gets project access by role assignment, Carol gets explain-others delegation, Eve is denied, then Bob is revoked and denied.

request.description: Resets demo data variables for a fresh run, then calls a real health endpoint.
Creates the owner account.

exec: pm.test('Current user fields exist', function () { pm.expect(json).to.include.keys('userId', 'email', 'displayName'); });

request.description: Captures owner tokens.
Creates Carol Admin.

exec: pm.test('Current user fields exist', function () { pm.expect(json).to.include.keys('userId', 'email', 'displayName'); });

request.description: Captures Carol tokens.
Creates Bob Developer.

exec: pm.test('Current user fields exist', function () { pm.expect(json).to.include.keys('userId', 'email', 'displayName'); });

request.description: Captures Bob tokens.
Creates Eve No Access.

exec: pm.test('Current user fields exist', function () { pm.expect(json).to.include.keys('userId', 'email', 'displayName'); });

request.description: Captures Eve tokens.
Alice creates the workspace.
Alice adds Bob to the workspace.

exec: pm.test('Bob is active member', function () { pm.expect(json.userId).to.eql(pm.environment.get('developerUserId')); pm.expect(json.status).to.eql('Active'); });

request.description: Alice adds Carol to the workspace.

exec: pm.test('Carol is active member', function () { pm.expect(json.userId).to.eql(pm.environment.get('adminUserId')); pm.expect(json.status).to.eql('Active'); });

request.description: Alice adds Eve as an active but unprivileged member.

exec: pm.test('Eve is active member', function () { pm.expect(json.userId).to.eql(pm.environment.get('noAccessUserId')); pm.expect(json.status).to.eql('Active'); });

request.description: Alice creates a project/resource.
Finds the platform permission needed to let delegated users call /authorization/check.

exec: pm.test('platformPermissionKey exists in permission catalog', function () { pm.expect(item, 'platformPermissionKey item').to.exist; });

request.description: Finds explain-others platform permission for Carol.

exec: pm.test('explainPermissionKey exists in permission catalog', function () { pm.expect(item, 'explainPermissionKey item').to.exist; });

request.description: Confirms pg.authorization.check_other_users exists in the platform catalog.

exec: pm.test('checkOtherPermissionKey exists in permission catalog', function () { pm.expect(item, 'checkOtherPermissionKey item').to.exist; });

request.description: Creates a project-scoped permission Bob will receive.
Creates a permission Bob will not receive, proving deny-by-default/no applicable grant.

body.raw:
{
  "key": "{{deniedPermissionKey}}",
  "displayName": "Approve documents",
  "description": "Permission intentionally not granted to Bob.",
  "module": "Documents",
  "allowedScopes": "Project",
  "isRequestable": true
}

request.description: Role grants Bob the custom permission and pg.authorization.check so authorization checks can be demonstrated.

exec: pm.test('Role contains the custom permission', function () { pm.expect(json.permissionIds).to.include(pm.environment.get('customPermissionId')); });

item.name: 20 Assign Role To Bob On Project

request.description: Alice grants Bob the project role.

exec: pm.test('Bob assignment is active or scheduled', function () { pm.expect(['Active', 'Scheduled']).to.include(json.status); });

request.description: Carol gets pg.authorization.explain_others and pg.authorization.check, but not pg.authorization.check_other_users.
Delegates explain-other capability to Carol at project scope.

body.raw:
{
  "userId": "{{adminUserId}}",
  "roleId": "{{adminExplainRoleId}}",
  "scopeType": "Project",
  "scopeId": "{{projectId}}",
  "startsAtUtc": "{{startsAtUtc}}",
  "expiresAtUtc": "{{expiresAtUtc}}",
  "reason": "Allow Carol to explain project access during demo."
}

request.description: Alice checks Bob's custom permission. Expected allow via RoleAssignment.

exec: pm.test('Bob is allowed by role assignment', function () { pm.expect(json.allowed).to.eql(true); pm.expect(json.reasonCode).to.eql('ALLOWED_ROLE_PERMISSION_MATCH'); });

request.description: Alice explains Bob's custom permission. Expected allow and RoleAssignment matched path.

exec: pm.test('Explanation matches allowed role assignment', function () { pm.expect(json.allowed).to.eql(true); pm.expect(json.reasonCode).to.eql('ALLOWED_ROLE_PERMISSION_MATCH'); pm.expect(json.matchedPath.type).to.eql('RoleAssignment'); });
pm.test('Explanation has summary and steps', function () { pm.expect(json.summary).to.be.a('string').and.is.not.empty; pm.expect(json.steps).to.be.an('array').and.is.not.empty; });

request.description: Eve is an active member but has no applicable grant.

item.name: 26 Owner Check Bob Ungranted Permission Denied

request.description: Bob does not have the second custom permission.

exec: pm.test('Bob is denied ungranted permission', function () { pm.expect(json.allowed).to.eql(false); pm.expect(json.reasonCode).to.eql('DENIED_NO_APPLICABLE_GRANT'); });

request.description: Carol can explain Bob because she has pg.authorization.explain_others.

item.name: 28 Carol Check Bob Denied Without check_other_users

request.description: Carol has explain_others but not check_other_users, so check-other returns a denied decision.

exec: pm.test('check_other_users is distinct from explain_others', function () { pm.expect(json.allowed).to.eql(false); pm.expect(json.reasonCode).to.eql('DENIED_CHECK_OTHER_USERS_NOT_ALLOWED'); });

request.description: Alice revokes Bob's access.

item.name: 30 Owner Check Bob After Revoke Denied

request.description: After revoke, Bob no longer has the custom permission.

exec: pm.test('Bob is denied after revoke', function () { pm.expect(json.allowed).to.eql(false); pm.expect(json.reasonCode).to.eql('DENIED_NO_APPLICABLE_GRANT'); });

item.name: 31 Owner Explain Bob After Revoke Denied

request.description: Explanation now follows the denied final decision.

exec: pm.test('Explanation is denied after revoke', function () { pm.expect(json.allowed).to.eql(false); pm.expect(json.reasonCode).to.eql('DENIED_NO_APPLICABLE_GRANT'); pm.expect(json.matchedPath).to.eql(null); });
